clue.text: Ignorant Ramist misconstrued Pythagorean theory

indicators.note: something misconstrued has been wrongly put together, so the preceding words are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, fourteen letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A follower of the logician Ramus gets the teachings of Pythagoras badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: A Ramist follows Petrus Ramus, a Renaissance logician; both words are the raw letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Pythagoras taught that the soul passes after death into another body, the doctrine known by this name.

clue.text: Carry round beer extracts in darkness

indicators.note: round says one word is placed around the others, enclosing them

blocks.note: to tote is to carry
ale is a beer
clips are short extracts, as from a film

explanation.surface: Someone lugs a crate of beer and some film excerpts around in the dark.
explanation.walkthrough: Carry wraps round both the beer and the extracts together, not just the beer.
explanation.definitionFit: When the moon wholly blocks the sun, the day goes dark, so the event is an example of darkness.

clue.text: Part of the morning on top of Golgotha

indicators.note: the top of a down entry word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: a.m. denotes the morning
taken as written
first letter of the place of the Crucifixion

explanation.surface: A moment from the morning of the Crucifixion, up on the hill of Golgotha.
explanation.definitionFit: Being among a group means being included in it, which is to be counted as one member of that group.

clue.text: Secret pro and the trauma she engendered

indicators.note: engendered means brought forth or produced, so the letters are generated in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A secretly paid sportsman and the emotional damage a woman caused.
explanation.definitionFit: A sportsperson who claims amateur status while secretly taking payment is effectively a professional in disguise.

clue.text: Look closely at small creature keeping quiet

indicators.note: keeping means holding inside, so one piece is lodged within the other

blocks.note: an insect is a small creature
p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone peers hard at a tiny animal that is keeping silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine something carefully, scrutinising it in detail.

clue.text: Fabulous bird turned up in the CP's archive

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means the word is flipped to read from bottom to top
in places one piece inside another

blocks.note: the roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend
the Communist Party's members are Reds

explanation.surface: A mythical bird has turned up among the Communist Party's papers.
explanation.definitionFit: Records are the stored documents of an organisation, which together make up its archive.

clue.text: Toad's feature reflected by plate of fish

indicators.note: a reflection shows things the other way round, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: toads are known for their warty skin
an L-plate marks a learner driver in Britain

explanation.surface: A toad's face seen reflected in a dish of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plate of fish' reads as a dish; plate is the L-plate and fish is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To trawl is to fish by dragging a large net along behind a boat.

clue.text: A long time in alternative treatment

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other

blocks.note: an era is a long period
an option is an alternative

explanation.surface: Someone spends ages trying complementary medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alternative treatment' suggests herbal remedies; the answer is surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical operation is a form of medical treatment carried out on a patient.

clue.text: God a woman?  ...

blocks.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether God might be female, leading into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the answer is just one woman's name, as borne by the actress Thora Hird.
explanation.definitionFit: Thora is a female first name, so it stands as an example of a woman.

clue.text: ... Ergo, boxes with philosopher

blocks.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, i.e. so
crates are boxes

explanation.surface: Continuing the God question: therefore a philosopher gets into the ring for a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boxes' looks like a verb about fighting; it is a plural noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian thinker who taught Plato is the most famous philosopher of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Point to competitive riders drinking half of cassis in northeast London

definitions.note: describes a place, while the answer names it

indicators.note: half of keeps only one half of the word's letters, here the back half
drinking means taking something in, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: S, south, is a compass point
eventers compete on horseback in eventing
last half of the blackcurrant liqueur

explanation.surface: Pointing horse riders towards a blackcurrant drink in a London district.
explanation.walkthrough: Eventing is the equestrian sport combining dressage, cross-country and showjumping.
explanation.definitionFit: Seven Sisters is a district and Tube station in Tottenham, in the north-east of London.

clue.text: Bags of silence aboard toboggan

indicators.note: something aboard a vehicle is carried inside it

blocks.note: to gag is to silence
a luge is a racing toboggan

explanation.surface: Plenty of hush on a sledge ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bags of' reads as 'lots of'; Bags alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Luggage is the collection of suitcases and holdalls a traveller carries, that is, bags.

clue.text: Let out (again?)

blocks.note: first meaning: set free
second meaning: let out again, as a landlord renting a property once more

explanation.walkthrough: Split as RE-LEASE, the word means to let (rent) out again; the question mark admits the play.
explanation.definitionFit: To release is to free or let go; to re-lease is to rent a property out for a further term.

clue.text: Dishonestly borrow from dopehead behind bars

indicators.note: behind bars means locked inside, so one piece is enclosed

blocks.note: the head of dope is its first letter
a cage is made of bars

explanation.surface: Scrounging off a drug user who is in prison.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dopehead' must be split: head means just the first letter of dope.
explanation.definitionFit: To cadge is to scrounge or get something by begging, with no intention of repaying.

clue.text: Knock peg out, taking in Bath University jamboree

indicators.note: taking in means admitting inside, so one piece goes within another

blocks.note: to peg out is slang for to die
Bath is a famous spa town
rag week is a British student charity carnival

explanation.surface: Someone criticises a tent peg coming loose at a student festival in Bath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bath University' reads as one institution; Bath gives SPA and University jamboree gives RAG.
explanation.definitionFit: To knock someone is informally to criticise or belittle them, which is what disparaging means.

clue.text: Sample spin doctor with TV set that's faulty

indicators.note: faulty means not working properly, so the pieces are jumbled

blocks.note: Dr is the abbreviation for doctor
taken as written
i.e. stands for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A political spin doctor tries out a television that turns out to be broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spin doctor' looks like one phrase; spin belongs to the definition as a drive.
explanation.definitionFit: A spin is a short drive, and to sample one before buying a car is to take it out on trial.

clue.text: Pretty female vicars needed for washing up?

blocks.note: a dish is an attractive person
the cloth means the clergy collectively

explanation.surface: An attractive woman and some clergy are called upon to do the dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitchen dishes are wiped clean with this fabric square after a meal, so it is required at the sink.

clue.text: Almost provide cover for fellow rebel

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

blocks.note: to insure is to provide insurance cover
a gent is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: Nearly offering protection to a comrade in the uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is someone who rises in armed revolt against authority, so a rebel.

clue.text: A palfrey almost slipped in piece of headgear

indicators.note: almost means falling just short, so the final letter goes
slipped means slid out of place, so the letters are disarranged

blocks.note: taken as written
the riding horse loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A rider's horse nearly slipped, and the rider was wearing a hat.
explanation.walkthrough: A palfrey is a gentle riding horse of medieval times.
explanation.definitionFit: An earflap hangs from a cap to cover the ear, so it is one part of a hat.

clue.text: Dug shaft for conveyor of refreshments

blocks.note: a dug is an animal's udder or teat
a shaft of light is a ray

explanation.surface: Someone digs a pit to carry drinks down to the workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dug' reads as the past of dig; it is the noun for an udder.
explanation.definitionFit: Cups, pot and biscuits are carried in on this flat board, which is what brings people their tea.

clue.text: One in the star's back cavity

indicators.note: back means going the other way, so the word is read in reverse
in puts one piece inside another

blocks.note: Roman numeral for one
the sun is our star

explanation.surface: Someone sits in the hollow at the back of a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinus is an air-filled hollow in the bones of the skull, a bodily cavity.

clue.text: Southern prospector's tool

blocks.note: abbreviation for southern
a panner washes gravel in a pan to find gold

explanation.surface: The equipment of a gold prospector from the South.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive just leads on to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A spanner is a hand tool for gripping and turning nuts and bolts.

clue.text: Fussy about hospital providing a suitable place

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one word goes round the other

blocks.note: nice can mean fastidious or fussy
H is the abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A particular patient is picky about the hospital bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Nice in its old sense means overly precise or particular.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a role or position that suits someone exactly, a fitting spot.

clue.text: A blemish is produced by a parasitic worm ...

blocks.note: taken as written
a scar is a blemish
taken as written

explanation.surface: A skin mark is caused by a parasitic worm, which continues into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascaris is the genus of large roundworms that live as parasites in the intestine.

clue.text: Famous person upholding drug charges

indicators.note: read as up plus holding: up, in a down entry, means reading the word from the bottom, and holding means it encloses another piece

blocks.note: a star is a celebrity
E is ecstasy

explanation.surface: A celebrity backs a drug and faces charges.
explanation.definitionFit: Rates are fees or prices asked, such as hourly rates, so they are charges.

clue.text: ... carrying blood and causing a row (curtailed) in the French department

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short, so the last letter is removed
in places one piece within the other

blocks.note: the Var is a French department in Provence
to scull is to row, here losing its last letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: Continuing the worm: it carries blood and starts a quarrel in a region of France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' reads as a quarrel; it is rowing a boat. The Var is a department of south-east France.
explanation.definitionFit: Vascular describes the vessels of the body that convey blood and other fluids.

clue.text: Shocking gay activists shedding silver

indicators.note: shedding means casting off, so those letters are removed

blocks.note: OutRage! was a British gay-rights campaign group
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Campaigners cause scandal by throwing off their silver jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré, borrowed from French, means unconventional to the point of being startling or improper.

clue.text: Deals involving Lang and Hitchcock productions: is this 1 across?

indicators.note: involving means wrapping up within, so one word goes round the others

blocks.note: to mete out is to deal out
M is a 1931 film by Fritz Lang
Psycho is Hitchcock's 1960 thriller
taken as written

explanation.surface: Business with two film directors' works prompts the question of reincarnation.
explanation.walkthrough: Productions covers both directors: Lang made the 1931 thriller M. The answer is a synonym of 1 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name the passing of a soul into a new body after death, so they are synonyms.
